messages.content: Return only the requested English text. Do not add a preface or word/token count.

Make only minimal grammar or punctuation corrections; preserve wording and meaning.

The administration could not say why $28 million was needed for a grant-in-aid program. The effectiveness of the governor in clearing up some of the inconsistencies revolving about the sales tax bill may play a part in determining whether it can muster the required two-thirds vote. The tax bill will be up for reconsideration Wednesday in the House when the Legislature reconvenes. Davis may use the tax bill as a means to effect a transition from special sessions of the Legislature to normalcy. If it fails to pass, he can throw up his hands and say the Legislature would not support him in his efforts to prevent integration.
